title: TGW: Operating an Efficient and Resilient Cloud Gateway at Scale
problem: Cloud gateways must efficiently handle massive scale while maintaining high resilience and fault tolerance; current systems struggle with resource utilization and failure recovery under production load.
motivation: Cloud gateways are critical infrastructure through which all cloud traffic flows, so efficiency and resilience directly impact operational costs and service reliability across the cloud platform.
method: TGW directs incoming requests to servers efficiently and spreads them evenly across servers to prevent overload. When a server fails, the system automatically detects it and redirects traffic to working servers. By combining intelligent routing with automatic recovery, the gateway efficiently handles large-scale traffic.
key_novelty: TGW operates cloud gateways at scale by distributing requests intelligently and automatically recovering when servers fail.
contributions: Efficient gateway architecture that reduces resource consumption under high-scale cloud traffic
Resilient design with fast failure detection and automated recovery mechanisms
Operational strategies and practices for managing gateways at production scale
Empirical evaluation demonstrating improvements in real cloud deployments

metrics.other: throughput, latency, availability, resource efficiency, recovery time

limitations: Not discussed due to lack of abstract.
